answer: Make every new identity post a reputation bond that vests slowly: an agent earns spending rights only after its bond survives several epochs of honest, peer-checked work, and the bond is slashed if its behavior matches a Sybil cluster. A whisper of fresh accounts carries no weight, because the signal that matters is a bond that has aged without a slash — just as an orchard yields fruit only after seasons of tending. Spinning up a thousand fake agents then means locking a thousand bonds for months, which costs far more than any reward a Sybil could extract.
